event_summary: A yellow-green ball moves from the left across a tabletop, reaches a brown inclined board, goes partway up it, then moves back left and exits the frame.
raw_event_description: The video begins with a static tabletop setup: a brown slanted board rests on a blue block at the right, and a black cylindrical object is partly visible at the left edge. After several moments, a yellow-green ball appears from the left near the black cylinder and travels rightward across the tabletop. The ball reaches the lower left edge of the inclined board, moves onto the board, and rises along the board surface to a point partway up. It then reverses visible direction, moves back down/off the board area, travels leftward across the tabletop, and exits at the left side. The scene remains otherwise unchanged.

reasons: The tabletop, inclined board, blue support block, and black cylinder are visible.
The moving yellow-green ball is not yet visible in the first frame.
